question: Who became the global Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Bata Shoe Organization?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sandeep Kataria**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sandeep Kataria** became the global Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Bata Shoe Organization.
 
• Sandeep Kataria joined Bata in 2020 as its chief executive officer after serving as a chief commercial officer at Vodafone.
 
• In his nearly 25-year-long career, the IIT-Delhi alumni, has worked across large consumer-facing businesses including Hindustan Unilever.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• **​The Bata Corporation** is a multinational footwear, apparel and fashion accessories manufacturer. 

 
 
• Founded: 24 August 1894, Zlín, Czechia
 
• Customer service: 1800 419 2282
 
• Headquarters: Lausanne, Switzerland
 
• CEO: Sandeep Kataria (Dec 2020–Present)
 
• Founder: Tomáš Baťa
